pages.text: “As peonies bloom under the dim light, clarity comes at a small cost.”$(br2)Herbaceous Peony Tea is a medicinally fragrant tea made from dried peony petals and sugar. Drinking it grants Night Vision but also inflicts slight damage upon consumption.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Herbaceous Peony Tea, $(br)boil dried peony petals with sugar.$(br)It is useful for nighttime exploration, but be aware—its effects are not without consequences.

Upon drinking Herbaceous Peony Tea, travelers gain Night Vision but take minor damage.$(br)This tea is suitable for nighttime expeditions but should be used with caution.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
